scope: WHOOP 4 historical version-25 transport frame and inner record
basis: Transport frame is the exact pinned v25 test literal; test input and canonical inner record are deterministic slices of that frame.

transport_frame.basis: Exact pinned v25 test literal, including 4-byte header, 76-byte inner record, and 4-byte trailing CRC32.

pinned_test_input.basis: Mechanically transport_frame.raw_hex[4:] (the exact 80-byte input produced by pinned test/v25_test.dart:10-13 via _innerHex; it intentionally includes the trailing CRC32).

inner_record.basis: Deterministic canonical slice of the pinned full frame: raw[4:-4].
inner_record.derivation: Mechanically slice transport_frame.raw_hex[4:-4]: remove the 4-byte frame header and 4-byte trailing CRC32; canonical inner record is 76 bytes.

expected_decode.basis: Loopr missing-data rule: missing input produces an absent metric, not zero, a substitute, or an invented score (docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:107); timestamp, counter, and acceleration remain supported and present.

raw_decoder_output_provenance: Pinned decoder zero/empty values preserved verbatim from test/v25_test.dart:16-38 and the v25 decoder field map; these are raw decoder output, not measured Loopr semantic values.

decoder_strategy.name: parseR24.v25_layout
decoder_strategy.expected_result: v25 auto-routes; timing and gravity decode, while HR, RR, and unsupported optical fields are absent/unsupported in Loopr semantics

verification: Dart unavailable; no runtime execution. Full-frame length, raw[4:] test-input length/content, raw[4:-4] canonical slice, offset decodes, and four-decimal acceleration rounding are mechanically validated against pinned v25 test/source behavior.
